_comment: Tier Policy configuration. Save as .amp/tier-policy.json in the repository root. Delete this file to fall back to defaults.
_mode: enforce = block and prompt by tier. observe = classify and log only, never block. Start in observe to see what would fire before switching on enforcement.
_context: Escalation modifiers describing this repository. Each true value raises every action one tier, capped at T3. T4 is never reached by escalation.
_overrides: Per-rule tier overrides by taxonomy ID, e.g. { "C2": 2 } to downgrade dependency installs from approval to notify. Deviation from the baseline is recorded here so it is explicit and auditable rather than requiring a fork.
_redact: Strip credential-shaped substrings from commands before writing them to the decision log.
_strictDialect: Apply only the detected shell dialect's patterns. Default false: detection is heuristic, and a wrong guess silently disables the other dialect's rules. Matching both risks visible false positives instead of invisible false negatives.
_logInputPreview: Write the raw tool payload to the log. Diagnostic only; payloads may contain sensitive data.
